Deadline on Instagram: "Alex Cross will be back for another go-round. Prime Video announced Wednesday it has renewed the hit thriller series #Cross for an eight-episode third season.⁠
⁠
Created by Ben Watkins based on James Patterson’s bestselling novels, 'Cross' stars Aldis Hodge as the brilliant and complex detective Alex Cross. Season 3 will continue to expand the high-stakes world of the iconic character, according to Prime.⁠
⁠
More details at the link in bio. (Photo: Prime Video)"
content.text: Alex Cross will be back for another go-round. Prime Video announced Wednesday it has renewed the hit thriller series #Cross for an eight-episode third season.⁠⁠Created by Ben Watkins based on James Patterson’s bestselling novels, 'Cross' stars Aldis Hodge as the brilliant and complex detective Alex Cross. Season 3 will continue to expand the high-stakes world of the iconic character, according to Prime.⁠⁠More details at the link in bio. (Photo: Prime Video)I enjoyed season 2 outside of that unnecessary romance between Cross and ole girl. The finale had my jaw on the floor!Aight Brother, season 2 was slow. Tell the writers to lock in for season 3 pleaseAND PLEASE put Elle and Cross back together.Yay! But the show definitely needs a new Showrunner/writers. This season‘s storyline was not as thrilling as season 1, and the romance between Cross and Kayla seemed forced and unauthentic. We’re counting on season 3 to restore a lot of love and faith us dedicated viewers lost this season!I expected so much more with season 2 after how good season 1 was 🫠 hope season 3 is 🔥AMAZING how all of you didn't like this season but it was the season that shed light on something that REALLY happens to our children and the corruption in the justice system.
